The `module_java` worktrees contain a BlueJ-style predator-prey simulation (default package, no build file). Core model: `Actor` → `Consumer`/`Producer` → concrete species; `Field`/`Location` grid; `Simulator` orchestrates; `SimulatorView` (Swing) + `StatisticsView` (JavaFX).

**Build:** JavaFX is NOT installed in this environment, so `javac *.java` fails only on `Simulator.java` + `StatisticsView.java` (javafx imports). The model compiles cleanly. To get a full local compile, write minimal stub classes for the javafx symbols used and compile with `-cp <stubs>` — the rest of the project is plain Java/Swing/AWT.

**Deterministic testing:** `Randomizer` uses a fixed seed (10001) via `Randomizer.reset()`, so `Simulator.populate()` placement is reproducible and can be regression-hashed. Caveat: `Gender.getRandom()` uses `Math.random()` (NOT the seeded RNG), so exclude gender from any golden-value comparison.

**R003_module_java refactor done (2026-06-27): species registry.** This is a base-family variant (`Actor`→`Consumer`/`Producer`→species; seed 10001; Gender via Math.random()). `Simulator` previously kept species data in THREE parallel places (10 `*_CREATION_PROBABILITY` consts, 10 `*_COLOR` consts + 10 hardcoded `view.setColor(...)` calls, and a 10-branch if/else-if chain in `populate()` tagged `// Refactor this?`). Introduced new `SpeciesDescriptor.java` (class holding species `Class`, `Color`, creationProbability, + `@FunctionalInterface ActorFactory create(Field,Location)`) and a single `static final List<SpeciesDescriptor> SPECIES` (10 entries in population-priority order). populate() now loops SPECIES with `if(rand.nextDouble()<=d.getCreationProbability()){actors.add(d.create(...));break;}` — the for-loop-with-break is the exact desugaring of the cascade, so same nextDouble draw count/order per cell. Colour setup loops SPECIES then one explicit `view.setColor(Carcass.class, CARCASS_COLOR)` (carcasses are produced dynamically, not seeded → kept out of SPECIES). Adding a species = one list entry. **Verified behaviour-preserving:** standalone equivalence test (old if/else vs new loop) over all 19200 cells of the default 120×160 grid with `new Random(10001)` → 0 mismatches AND random stream stays aligned afterward (so any seeded populate() regression hash is unchanged). Full project compile-checked via a one-file `javafx.application.Application` stub + stub `StatisticsView` (only Simulator/StatisticsView need javafx). Did NOT fix the latent `depth<=0||depth<=0` width-validation bug at Simulator ctor (out of scope; doesn't affect default-size runs). **Dead code flagged but NOT removed (didn't author it):** `Animal.java`/`Rabbit.java`/`Fox.java` are a self-contained legacy foxes-and-rabbits cluster (`extends Animal`, `List<Animal>`), unreferenced by the active `Actor` hierarchy — recommended deletion to user. **UPDATE: user confirmed; `git rm`'d Animal.java/Rabbit.java/Fox.java (grep-verified zero remaining refs).** Then a second refactor: removed the do-nothing `act(List<Actor>)` overrides from ALL 10 concrete species (each just called `super.act(...)` — pure boilerplate; inherited Consumer.act/Producer.act runs identically, behaviour-preserving by language semantics, no RNG change). For the 3 producers (Acacia/StarGrass/RedOatGrass) this also let me drop their now-unused `import java.util.List;` + already-unused `Iterator`/`Random` imports. Consumers keep List/ArrayList imports (still used by `PREY = new ArrayList<>(List.of(...))`). Full project re-compiles clean via the javafx Application stub (32 classes). Third refactor (R003): dead-code removal in `Field.java` — grep-confirmed zero callers, removed `randomAdjacentLocation(Location)`, the entire `producerField` field + `createProducerField()` + `getProducerField()` cluster, the unused 3-arg `place(Object,int,int)` overload (only real caller Actor.java:119 uses the 2-arg Location version), and the unused `import java.util.Iterator`. Behaviour-preserving (none were invoked; `randomAdjacentLocation` would have consumed rand via shuffle but was never called). Recompiles clean (32 classes). Fourth refactor (R003): `SimulatorView` button listeners. The 3 buttons (4000 Steps/Reset/One Step) each had a verbose anonymous `ActionListener` repeating the same "if any conflicting thread isAlive→return; else field=new Thread(op); start()" guard. Extracted two static helpers — `anyAlive(Thread...)` (guard) and `startThread(Runnable)` (launch+return) — and converted the 3 anonymous classes to lambdas. Behaviour-identical: each button still checks the SAME thread set and assigns the SAME field (longSim blocks on {runLong,oneStep}; reset on {reset,runLong,oneStep}; oneStep on {oneStep,runLong} — preserved exactly, incl. the asymmetry that longSim/oneStep don't check resetThread). Also removed dead `setInfoText(String)` (grep-confirmed zero callers; infoLabel kept — still in layout). Compiles clean: 29 classes (was 32 — the 3 anonymous `SimulatorView$1/$2/$3` are gone, lambdas use invokedynamic). NOTE still-pending trivial dead code noted but NOT done: unused `import java.awt.Color` in BOTH Counter.java and FieldStats.java (neither uses Color); also `import java.awt.event.*` in SimulatorView is now unused after the lambda conversion. Left for a future pass. **DONE in fifth refactor.**

Fifth refactor (R003): unused-import sweep + day/weather system simplification. (a) Removed the 3 dead imports flagged above (`java.awt.Color` from Counter.java + FieldStats.java; `java.awt.event.*` from SimulatorView.java). (b) `TimeSystem`: extracted night-window magic numbers to named constants `NIGHT_START=0.8`/`NIGHT_END=0.2`; `getCurrentDay()` dropped redundant `(int)` cast + temp var (int/int already int); `hasDayChanged()` now caches `getCurrentDay()` in a local (was calling it 3×) and uses early-return instead of if/else; `isNightTime()` returns the boolean expression directly (kept the exact `>NIGHT_START && <1.0 || >0.0 && <NIGHT_END` condition — timeOfDay∈[0,1), so unchanged semantics). (c) `WeatherSystem.changeToNextDay()`: `if(rand.nextInt(2)==1) isRaining=true; else isRaining=false;` → `isRaining = rand.nextInt(2)==1;` (RNG-preserving: still exactly one nextInt(2) draw); also deleted the dangling incomplete trailing `// The weather should change...` comment after the class brace. All behaviour-preserving, no RNG-order change. Comparison is valid because only the model classes differ between baseline/refactored runs. Latent quirk left as-is: `Animal.setDead()` has dead no-op code (`if (class==Lion||Cheetah) location=null;` after location already nulled).

**R008 refactors done (2026-06-26), all verified behaviour-preserving vs the pristine baseline commit 298c765 across 4 harness configs (default 60×90/120-step + seeds 11/7/5, steps up to 200, varied grids). Canonical fingerprints under the FINAL harness (seeds LivingOrganism=SEED, Field=SEED+1, Weather=SEED+2): default=-8651955994381610381, [150 11 22]=3170458861844968265, [200 7 99]=7234180482974749471, [120 5 5 80 120]=-422301020194460238.** Harness lives at /tmp/harness/Harness.java (parametrized: `Harness [steps [seed [popseed [depth width]]]]`). 1. *Replace Conditional with Polymorphism for offspring creation.* `Animal.createNewOffspring` had a `Class classOfAnimal` if/else chain and an unused `motherFoodLevel` param → abstract `Animal createOffspring(Field,Location,boolean,boolean)` implemented per concrete species (mirrors `Plant.createOffspring`).
2. *Pull up duplicated constructor bodies.* The 5 near-identical species ctors now pass their constants to enriched `Prey`/`Predator` super-ctors that do the stat-assignment + age/food init. Prey ctor takes a `newbornFoodFraction` (added `NEWBORN_FOOD_FRACTION` consts: Zebra/Giraffe 0.25, Lemur 0.5); Predator ctor keeps the random newborn food (`rand.nextDouble()/5.5`). Public concrete ctor signatures unchanged.
3. *Extract Method on `Animal.act()`* (was ~85 lines) → `updateInfectionState()`/`tryToCatchDisease()`/`tryToBreed()`/`move()`, exact RNG-call order preserved (short-circuits matter, e.g. `surroundingsInfected() && rand.nextDouble()...`).
4. *Removed dead code in `Animal.setDead()`*: the `if (class==Lion||Cheetah) location=null;` block is unreachable-effect (location already nulled above).
5. *Extract duplicated neighbour iteration.* `Animal.breed()` and `surroundingsInfected()` both hand-rolled the same `adjacentLocations`+Iterator walk → shared `private List<Animal> getAdjacentAnimals()` (for-each, collects non-null neighbours). RNG-safe: `adjacentLocations()` shuffles via Field.rand and is still called exactly once per method call, same order; breed still draws `rand.nextInt(maxLitterSize)` per same-species male in shuffled order (last wins), surroundingsInfected still early-returns on first infected. 7. *`Simulator.populate()` table-driven.* Replaced the creation-probability if/else-if chain + redundant identity casts `(Lion) new Lion(...)` with a `private record SpeciesSpawn(double creationProbability, BiFunction<Field,Location,Animal> spawner)` + `static final List<SpeciesSpawn> SPECIES_SPAWNS` (5 entries, priority order) and a `for(SpeciesSpawn s: SPECIES_SPAWNS){ if(rand.nextDouble()<=s.creationProbability()){ animal=s.spawner().apply(field,location); break; } }` loop.    *Verification (Simulator is Swing-view-coupled so the model fingerprint harness can't call it):* built a separate driver that allocates a Simulator via `sun.misc.Unsafe.allocateInstance` (skips the JFrame-building ctor — works in Java 21 WITHOUT --add-opens), reflectively sets `field`/`animals`/`plants`, invokes the private `populate()`, and FNV-fingerprints species-per-cell. With a deterministic test-double `Randomizer.getRandom()` returning `new Random(4242)`, baseline (git 298c765 Simulator.java) vs refactored both gave FP=8100322877308688392 (1351 animals/5400 plants, 60×90), stable across runs. Model harness (4 configs) unchanged. Driver/sources under /tmp/popverify.

8. *Remove dead code + simplify getTimeString.* Deleted 5 genuinely-uncalled methods (grep-confirmed zero callers): `Field.randomAdjacentLocation(Location)`, `Field.place(Object,int,int)` overload, `GridSpace.getAnimal()`, `GridSpace.getPlant()`, `Simulator.delay(int)`. Simplified `SimulatorView.getTimeString()`'s nested if/else to `String.format("%02d:00 ", Time.getTime())` (verified identical over all 24 hour values via /tmp/timecheck). Model harness (4 configs) + populate driver (FP=8100322877308688392) both unchanged. NOTE left untouched: `Field.place(Object,Location)`'s `if(gridSpace==null){gridSpace=new GridSpace();}` branch is dead AND latently buggy (never writes the new GridSpace back to the array) — but cells are always cleared() first so it never triggers; leaving as a known latent quirk.

9. *Enum-based `Species` single source of truth.* New `Species.java` enum (LION,CHEETAH,ZEBRA,GIRAFFE,LEMUR in population-priority order) holds per-species: `speciesClass()`, `creationProbability()`, `fillColor()`, `textColor()`, `spawn(field,location)` (BiFunction). Replaced in `Simulator`: the 5 `*_CREATION_PROBABILITY` constants, the round-7 `SpeciesSpawn` record + `SPECIES_SPAWNS` list, and the 5 hardcoded animal `view.setColor(...)` calls. populate() now loops `Species.values()`; constructor colour setup loops `Species.values()` then one explicit `view.setColor(Plant.class, GREEN, BLACK)` (Plant is not part of the animal spawn cascade, kept separate). Removed Simulator's `import java.util.function.BiFunction`. Adding a species = one enum constant. 10. *Replace Magic Number with Named Constant (polish).* Named the inline rule probabilities: Animal `OVERCROWDING_DEATH_PROBABILITY=0.3`, `IMMUNITY_LOSS_DIVISOR=15`, `OFFSPRING_IMMUNITY_INHERITANCE_PROBABILITY=0.15`, `OFFSPRING_IMMUNITY_LOSS_PROBABILITY=0.9`; Predator `NIGHT_ACTIVITY_CHANCE=0.25`, `FOG_ACTIVITY_CHANCE=0.50`. Left the disease field initialisers (already assigned to named fields) and ctor `/5.5` alone to avoid churn. Model harness (4 configs) unchanged.

Verified by perturbing the identity-hashCode PRNG (`System.identityHashCode(new Object())` ×N before building the engine): pre-fix N=0/7/100/5000 gave 4 different fingerprints; post-fix all give -2184605646102145951. Consequence for future work: cross-process fingerprint comparison is now VALID. Still use a POSITION-sensitive signature (class+diseased per cell), not counts-only.

**Disease per-instance rates — FIXED (was `static`).** `Disease.PROPAGATION_RATE`/`LETHALITY_RATE` were `static`, so every disease returned the LAST-created instance's rates (≈17 distinct diseases exist right after populate but all behaved as one). Made them instance fields `propagationRate`/`lethalityRate` (and renamed `PROPAGATION_MODE`→`propagationMode`; `rand` is now a local in the default ctor). User OK'd the output change. Disease CONSTRUCTION RNG is unchanged (same 3 draws/ctor), so populate creates byte-identical diseases; divergence begins at STEP 1's propagation-death check (17 diseased orgs now use their own rates 0.0017–0.50 instead of all using the last-created ~0.50), cascading to a fully different but deterministic trace. After both fixes the canonical engine-harness fingerprint (160x240, 150 steps, position-sensitive) is **-8012133067710255676** (was -2184605646102145951 pre-Disease-fix). No known latent simulation bugs remain after this.

Adding a species = one enum constant. Model behaviour verified unchanged (fingerprint still -8012133067710255676); GUI is reasoning-verified only (JFrame can't run here). Note: the checkbox column order changed to enum order and `setColorsByCheckBox` now includes Mouse (the old hardcoded array omitted it).

## Extract Method on `SimulatorView.showStatus()`

`showStatus()` mixed abstraction levels: high-level label updates (`stepLabel`, `population`, weather/day) sat alongside a low-level nested loop walking every grid cell to draw and count. I extracted the rendering loop into a new private method:

```java
private void drawFieldContents(Field field) { ... }   // the per-cell draw + count loop
```

`showStatus()` now reads as a clean sequence of intent:
```
setVisible → stepLabel → stats.reset → preparePaint → drawFieldContents → countFinished → population → weather → day → repaint
```

The extraction is a **pure cut-paste** — the loop body is byte-for-byte identical, preserving the exact `reset → incrementCount-per-cell → countFinished` ordering, so the population text and counter values are unchanged. No RNG is involved.

## Verification
Compiles cleanly (29 classes, no errors). Behavior-preserving by construction.

## Recommendation: time to commit
That's **six** cohesive refactorings this session, all verified and behavior-preserving, but **nothing is committed yet** and the working tree now spans most of the codebase:

1. `Simulator` species registry (`SpeciesDescriptor`)
2. Deleted legacy `Animal`/`Rabbit`/`Fox`
3. Removed do-nothing `act()` overrides + dead producer imports
4. `Field` dead-code removal
5. `SimulatorView` button-listener lambdas + dead `setInfoText`
6. Unused imports + `TimeSystem`/`WeatherSystem` simplification
7. `showStatus` Extract Method

This is a natural checkpoint. **Shall I commit these changes now** (on the current branch) before continuing? That keeps the history reviewable in logical chunks rather than one sprawling diff. If you'd prefer, I can also keep going and commit later — just say which.
